retired.mechanism: Importer rule (game convert.js bgFor): a scene's own portraitBackground always wins and node backdrop is not an authorable field. Retirement therefore (1) moves the boiler_access#portraitBackground record and its public preview copy out of the active registry (record text, SHA-256 and pinned source preserved verbatim in docs/137 section 5 and git history; bytes stay at source commit 24c79bf) and (2) sets portraits[hotel_porter:alarmed].portraitBackgroundScene grand_bellevue/lobby -> grand_bellevue/service_passage. The lobby node hotel_chair_stapler_caught keeps the lobby background because the lobby scene has its own.
